summary: Validated update (valid; single effect: source_ids of the recovery-value family fact). With the interval nearly gone I spent it on a real, narrow improvement rather than another unchanged call: the family fact now cites the executor and decoder materials its own clauses depend on - the executor's admission guard, the batch-application block that marks an instance EXECUTED, the driver loop that advances ExecedUpTo, the exact admission-guard function bounds, and the two decoders whose make([]state.Command, alen1) turns a command-less reply into a non-nil empty slice. Clause (d) and the downstream no-op note previously rested on line numbers in prose alone; they now rest on registered ranges. Statement, conditions, executions, dependency pointers and every other citation are unchanged. Final state of the run: six questions with explained dispositions and controller receipts - the fabricated-self-ballot value adoption up to a completed contradiction of a live replica's committed value, bounded to coordinators lacking the command by an executed control run; recovery authority bounded by the recoverer's fixed ballot, with the rejection branch verified as a counter increment and return carrying no repair and the only repairs being the two IsLeader-gated proposal-phase restarts; the status-guard stall that clears only on the executor's retry; the client-completion contract holding for the single-NOOP case through re-propose but not for the empty batch; the wrong-row write in handlePreAccept refuted as unreachable; and the equal-ballot empty-slice replacement decided by the reply adopted at the slow-quorum trigger position, measured over all six permutations of the three-reply set and four orders of a two-carrier/two-empty set and final because only N - SlowQuorumSize replies can follow. Eleven receipts across six fixed experiments, eleven registered source materials spanning the recovery, executor and decoder paths, two facts and eight behaviour entries mutually consistent after this run's corrections, and the captured snapshot never modified.
